苏沐是真的没有想到,原本只是想着帮李乐天少花点冤枉钱,结个善缘,以后万一碰到好说话。结果事情会发展成现在这样,被对方几个人高马大的家伙给堵住,而且瞧他们的样子,分明是想着狠狠收拾自己一顿。
老子就是王法!
谢明浩的狂言听在苏沐耳中,不由被深深震住,在新社会竟然还有人敢这么狂妄,叫嚣自己就是王法。如果这家伙要是当官的,那他绝对是蠢货。如果他要没有任何官职,那就说明后台很强硬。
瞧着这古玩街看热闹人的眼神,便能瞧出谢明浩的实力不俗。而这些个人有的脸上是愤怒但却不敢上前,有的却是幸灾乐祸巴不得看稀罕,指望着他们出来帮忙,那是想都别想的事情。
“等下,谢明浩,姓谢,难不成这家伙是...”
苏沐脑中突然浮现一个人名,真要是那样的话,事情可就真的大条了。自己只不过是个副镇长,和堂堂邢唐县县委书记对上的话,结果是毋庸置疑的。
这可真是无妄之灾!
“王八蛋,我看看你们谁敢过来!”就在苏沐琢磨的时候李乐天却是顺手从旁边的架子上拎起一个青花瓷玉瓶。
“苏沐,怕不怕?你要是怕的话就先走,这里交给我。放心,只要我不死,这些蠢货便别想动你一根手指头。”
“怕?我怕什么!我还就不信了,这邢唐县什么时候论到一个混混当家作主?这天下难道不是我党的天下!李哥,我既然站出来就不会再退回去,这场官司我陪你打定了!”苏沐大声道。
事已至此,苏沐已经没有回头路。现在就算离开,依着谢明浩的性格也绝对不会放过自己。加上没记错的话,杨松应该便是县委书记谢文的人,要是让他知道这事,还不把小鞋给自己穿翻。
既然这样那就不如赌一把,就赌这个李乐天真的有些背景!
再不济,拥有着官榜,苏沐就算是混商场,那也是如鱼得水!
在退路都安排好的情况下,还有什么可顾虑的!
在黑山镇的小半年,苏沐被排挤,眼瞧着那群混蛋身居高位不思发展经济,就知道争权夺利,心中的那股憋屈在这时呼的涌上来。
要不说这人憋久了就容易出事,苏沐憋的够久,现在好不容易抓住机会,还不好好的发泄一番!
“够痛快!苏沐,今天我李乐天把话撂在这里,你这兄弟我认定了!”李乐天意气风发的大笑道。
“笑,一会有你们哭的时候,给我上,全都拿下来!”谢明浩狞笑着扬起手臂,大声的喊道。

被五万块钱冲昏头脑的谢明浩,根本就没想着李乐天的不凡气质怎么能够是普通人,苏沐满嘴讲的是党天下又怎么会没点身份。这些统统都被谢明浩抛在脑后,他要做的便是将这两个不知天高地厚的家伙拿下。
只要送进公安局综合治安办,想要怎样还不由着他?到时候又能出气又能发笔大财,何乐而不为之?
想到这儿,谢明浩便大声喊叫着:“全都给我拿下,在这邢唐县还敢和我叫板,我就不信这个邪了!”
李乐天直接将玉瓶砸出去,砸烂的同时将一个家伙的脑袋给开了花。但很快他便被围住,陷入到困局。短暂的瞬间,身上便又挨了几下打,索性都不要紧,不然就这便够他好好喝一壶。
“瞧着身子骨不错,怎么这么不经打。”
苏沐无奈的摇摇头,这时候还得自己出马,虽然他还没有将形意拳的精髓领悟透彻,但对付几个小混混还是完全没有问题的。
“你就给我回来吧!”
苏沐一脚踢飞一个混混后,便将李乐天从前面拉了回来,放到身后,“你就站在这儿别动,交给我了!”
“嗨,既然你这么想打那就让给你打,我正好歇会。苏沐,狠狠打,好好收拾收拾这几个王八蛋!”李乐天在后面大声嚷道,却是没有再上前一步。
自家人知道自家事,李乐天还真不是打架的材料。
苏沐如同蛟龙般前进后退躲避,短短几息间便将几个混混全都撂倒在地,惨烈的呻吟声很快响起。
“好!苏沐,就你这功夫快要赶上我了,什么时候咱们兄弟俩个切磋切磋,让你也见识下什么叫做京都拳法。”李乐天大声喊道。

Su Mu really didn't expect it. Originally, she just wanted to help Li Letian spend less money and build a good relationship so that he would be easy to talk to if he met him in the future. As a result, things will develop like this, and they will be blocked by several tall guys from the other side, and looking at their appearance, they are clearly thinking of punishing themselves.
I am Wangfa!
When Su Mu heard Xie Minghao's arrogance, he couldn't help but be deeply shocked. In the new society, there are still people who dare to be so arrogant and claim that they are Wang Fa. If this guy is an official, he is definitely a fool. If he does not have any official position, it means that the backstage is very tough.
Looking at the eyes of the onlookers in this antique street, one can tell that Xie Minghao is quite capable. Some of these individuals had angry faces but did not dare to step forward, while others were gloating about the misfortune and eager to see what was happening. Counting on them to come out to help was something that was unthinkable.
"Wait a minute, Xie Minghao, whose surname is Xie, could this guy be..."
A name suddenly appeared in Su Mu's mind. If it were like that, things would be really serious. He is just a deputy mayor, and if he goes up against the dignified secretary of the Xingtang County Party Committee, there is no doubt about the outcome.
This is truly a disaster!
"You bastard, let's see who of you dares to come here!" Just as Su Mu was thinking about it, Li Letian picked up a blue and white porcelain jade vase from the shelf next to him.
"Su Mu, are you afraid? If you are afraid, leave first and leave this place to me. Don't worry, as long as I don't die, these idiots won't even think of laying a finger on you."
"Afraid? What am I afraid of! I don't believe it yet. When did Xingtang County talk about a gangster being the master of the country? Isn't this world a world owned by our party? Brother Li, since I have stood up, I will not go back. I will settle this lawsuit with you!" Su Mu said loudly.
Now that things have come to this, Su Mu has no way of turning back. Even if he leaves now, Xie Minghao's character will never let him go. If I remember correctly, Yang Song should be the person of Xie Wen, the county party secretary. If he knew about this, he would not wear out his little shoes.
In this case, why not take a gamble and bet that Li Letian really has some background!
No matter how bad it is, with the official list, Su Mu will be like a duck in water even if he works in the shopping mall!
With all the escape routes planned, there’s nothing left to worry about!
In the first half of the year in Heishan Town, Su Mu was squeezed out. Seeing those bastards who were in high positions and did not want to develop the economy, they knew how to fight for power and gain, and the frustration in her heart surged up at this moment.
Otherwise, this person would easily get into trouble if he held it in for a long time. Su Mu had held it in for a long enough time, and now he finally got the chance to let it out!
"That's enough! Su Mu, I, Li Letian, left my words here today, and I recognize you as a brother!" Li Letian laughed high-spiritedly.
"Smile, when you cry, come here and take them all down!" Xie Minghao raised his arms with a grin and shouted loudly.
Xie Minghao, who was dazzled by fifty thousand yuan, didn't even think about how Li Letian's extraordinary temperament could be an ordinary person, and how could Su Mu have no identity when he was talking about the party world. All these were forgotten by Xie Minghao. What he had to do was to take down these two guys who didn't know the heights of the world.
As long as he is sent to the Comprehensive Public Security Office of the Public Security Bureau, it is not up to him to do what he wants? Then he can vent his anger and make a fortune, so why not do it?
Thinking of this, Xie Minghao shouted loudly: "Take them all for me. If you dare to challenge me in Xingtang County, I don't believe this evil!"
Li Letian directly smashed the jade bottle out. When it was smashed, a guy's head was deflowered. But soon he was surrounded and fell into trouble. brief moment, he received a few more blows on his body, but it didn’t matter at all, otherwise this would be enough for him to have a good drink.
"You look like you have a good body, but why are you so unbeaten?"
Su Mu shook his head helplessly. At this time, he had to take action on his own. Although he had not fully understood the essence of Xingyiquan, he still had no problem dealing with a few gangsters.
"Just come back to me!"
After Su Mu kicked a gangster away, he pulled Li Letian back from the front and put him behind him, "Just stand here and don't move. Leave it to me!"
"Hey, since you want to beat me so much, I'll let you beat me. I'm taking a break. Su Mu, beat them hard, and take care of these bastards!" Li Letian shouted from behind, but he didn't take another step forward.
His family knows his own affairs, and Li Letian is really not a fight material.
Su Mu moved forward and backward to dodge like a dragon. In just a few breaths, he knocked all the gangsters to the ground, and tragic groans soon sounded.
"Okay! Su Mu, you are almost catching up with me now. Let's compete with each other and let you see what Kyoto Boxing is." Li Letian shouted loudly.
